lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Namaskara madam, naanu Kaveri Finance inda maathadthiddini. Lakshmi Narayan avara jothe maathadthiddeena?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you madam. For verification, can you please tell me your date of birth?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dhanyavaada madam. Nimma personal loan alli eradu EMI pending ide, September mattu October, prathi ondu five thousand six hundred, total eleven thousand two hundred rupees. Enaadru problem aaytha?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಹೌದು, August ಅಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ job ಹೋಯ್ತು. Company shut ಆಯ್ತು. ತುಂಬಾ ಕಷ್ಟ ಆಗಿತ್ತು.
lines.roman: Haudu, August alli nanna job hoythu. Company shut aaythu. Thumba kashta aagitthu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ayyo, kshamisi madam, adu thumba kashtada samaya. Eega paristhiti hegide? Bere kelasa sikkideya?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಹಾ, ಹೊಸ job ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದೆ, November ಅಲ್ಲಿ join ಆದೆ. First salary December first ಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತೆ.
lines.roman: Haa, hosa job sikkide, November alli join aade. First salary December first ge barutte.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Santhosha madam. Salary banda mele, eshtu kattoke saadhya aagutte anta anisutte?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Full eleven thousand ಒಂದೇ ಸಲ ಕಷ್ಟ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಕಟ್ಟಬಹುದು.
lines.roman: Full eleven thousand ondhe sala kashta. Aadre swalpa swalpa kattabahudu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: I understand. Just to be transparent, if this stays unpaid it gets reported to the credit bureaus and late charges keep adding. One option: pay one EMI, five thousand six hundred, on December third, and the second on December twentieth. Would that work?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಹಾ, ಅದು ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. Third ಗೆ ಒಂದು, twentieth ಗೆ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು.
lines.roman: Haa, adu aagutte. Third ge ondu, twentieth ge innondu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Super madam. Payment hege maadtheera, UPI na athava link kalisla?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: UPI ಇಂದ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, Google Pay ಇದೆ.
lines.roman: UPI inda maadthini, Google Pay ide.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Perfect. So to confirm: five thousand six hundred on December third and five thousand six hundred on December twentieth, through UPI. I will SMS the UPI ID to your registered number.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dhanyavaada madam, hosa kelasakke all the best.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer committed to clearing the full ₹11,200 overdue in two dated UPI payments of ₹5,600 on 3 and 20 December.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed two EMIs after losing her job in August; she has since joined a new company with first salary on 1 December. Agent showed empathy, assessed affordability and agreed a two-instalment plan covering the full overdue amount.
analysis.observations: Strong negotiation: explored the current situation before asking for money, explained bureau reporting factually, and structured an affordable split around the salary date. Only gap was the missing recording disclosure.
analysis.improvements: Add the call-recording disclosure during verification. Could also set a reminder call before 3 December given the recent job change.

op_greet_company.rationale: Greeted and named Kaveri Finance in the opening.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for date of birth before discussing the loan.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked 'Enaadru problem aaytha?' after stating dues.

ds_empathy.rationale: Apologised and acknowledged the job loss as a difficult time.

ds_ability_to_pay.rationale: Asked how much she could realistically pay once salary arrives.

ng_state_dues.rationale: Stated two missed EMIs (Sept, Oct) of ₹5,600 totalling ₹11,200.

ng_consequences.rationale: Explained credit-bureau reporting and added charges without threats.

ng_options.rationale: Offered a split into two dated instalments.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Consequences framed as 'just to be transparent'.

cp_respectful.rationale: Warm, respectful tone; wished her well on the new job.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Loan details shared only after DOB verification.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Customer agreed to ₹5,600 on 3 Dec and ₹5,600 on 20 Dec.

cl_recap.rationale: Repeated both amounts, dates and mode.

moments.label: UPI ID to be sent by SMS
